Marsiva MR-UF2000 2000VA Smart Line-Interactive UPS

The Marsiva MR-UF2000 2000VA Smart Line-Interactive UPS is a powerful and intelligent power backup solution, ideal for home, office, and small business environments. With a robust 2000VA / 1200W capacity, it delivers stable and uninterrupted power to computers, servers, routers, and other critical electronics.

Engineered with Smart Line-Interactive technology and Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR), the MR-UF2000 instantly corrects voltage fluctuations without switching to battery power—ensuring longer battery life and greater efficiency. It offers a simulated sine wave output, cold start function, and off-mode charging, making it a reliable and flexible choice for demanding setups.

Equipped with advanced safety features like overload, short circuit, and overcharge protection, as well as easy-to-read LED indicators and audible alarms, this UPS ensures total peace of mind. Compact and durable, it's built to deliver maximum uptime and device protection.


Key Features:

  • 2000VA / 1200W high power capacity
  • Smart Line-Interactive UPS with AVR
  • Simulated sine wave output for safe device compatibility
  • 12V high-capacity battery 9Ah
  • Cold start & intelligent off-mode charging
  • Short circuit, overload, and overcharge protection
  • LED indicators and audible alarms for real-time status
  • Ideal for PCs, servers, networking gear, and home entertainment systems
